title: Circular & Rotational Motion
intro: Spinning stones, cornering bodas, flywheels and grinding mills: the physics of going round.

lessons.title: Motion in Circles: Everywhere You Look
lessons.focus: Wheels, mills, merry-go-rounds, fans, steering; distinguish rotation (spinning) from revolution (orbiting).
lessons.advanced: Give three Kenyan machines using each: rotation about a fixed axle vs revolution around an external centre.

lessons.title: What Keeps It Circling? The Inward Pull
lessons.focus: Swing a soft ball on a string; cut the string mentally: ball flies off tangent; centripetal force is a requirement, not a new force.
lessons.advanced: A 0.5 kg ball at 3 m/s on a 1 m string: compute the centripetal force (F=mv²/r) and compare with its weight.

lessons.title: Sources of Centripetal Force
lessons.focus: String tension, tyre friction in cornering, gravity for the Moon, banked-track normal force; identify the provider in five cases.
lessons.advanced: Boda cornering at 10 m/s on radius 15 m: required friction force for 150 kg total; what happens on wet murram?

lessons.title: The Bucket of Water Overhead
lessons.focus: Teacher-led swing of a small water bucket overhead; why the water stays in; speed threshold felt at the shoulder.
lessons.advanced: Minimum speed at the top: set centripetal acceleration ≥ g; compute v_min for a 1 m arm.

lessons.title: Speed Around the Circle: v = 2πr/T
lessons.focus: Measure a merry-go-round or spinning wheel: count rotations, time them, compute rim speed.
lessons.advanced: Rim at 1.2 m radius turns once per 2.5 s: rim speed and centripetal acceleration (a=v²/r).

lessons.title: Why You Feel Flung Outward
lessons.focus: Inertia carries you straight while the vehicle turns; 'centrifugal force' as a felt effect; soap in the spinning basin demo.
lessons.advanced: Explain the sliding-passenger sensation from the ground frame without inventing a new force.

lessons.title: Leaning Bodas and Banked Corners
lessons.focus: Riders lean into corners; banked velodromes and railway curves; lean angle relates speed and radius.
lessons.advanced: tanθ = v²/(rg): compute the lean angle for 8 m/s on a 10 m radius corner.

lessons.title: The Herder's Sling: Release at the Right Moment
lessons.focus: Whirl a sling with a soft clay ball; release timing controls direction; safety protocols in an open field.
lessons.advanced: Release at height 1.5 m, speed 15 m/s horizontal: compute range and explain the best release point in the circle.

lessons.title: Grinding and Milling: Rotation at Work
lessons.focus: Kinu grinding stone, posho mill burrs; big slow wheels grind with torque; visit or diagram a posho mill's drivetrain.
lessons.advanced: Mill burr at 20 cm radius, 600 rpm: compute rim speed; why is high rim speed good for grinding?

lessons.title: Flywheels: Storing Rotation
lessons.focus: Posho mill and treadle wheels keep spinning through the dead spots; spin a heavy wheel and feel the persistence.
lessons.advanced: Explain with rotational inertia why mass at the rim stores more energy than mass at the hub.

lessons.title: Balancing a Wheel
lessons.focus: Unbalanced wheel shakes; find the heavy spot on a free bicycle wheel; add clay counterweight until smooth.
lessons.advanced: Explain why imbalance force grows with v² and what that means for a boda at speed.

lessons.title: The Gyroscope Effect: Spinning Means Stability
lessons.focus: Spinning tops, rolling coins, moving bicycles stay upright; stationary bike falls over; precession teaser on a swivel stool.
lessons.advanced: Use angular momentum direction-stability to explain why a rolling bicycle self-corrects small leans.

lessons.title: Rolling: Rotation Plus Translation
lessons.focus: A rolling wheel's rim point touching ground is momentarily still; rolling vs dragging a debe measured with a spring balance.
lessons.advanced: Mark the wheel contact point's path (cycloid) from chalk dots; argue why rolling friction is small.

lessons.title: Ball Bearings: Rolling Between Surfaces
lessons.focus: Open a boda hub (or diagram): balls roll instead of metals sliding; races, cages, grease; failure signs.
lessons.advanced: Estimate friction reduction sliding→rolling from hub temperatures felt before/after service; design a better test.

lessons.title: Axles and Torque: The Long Spanner Rule
lessons.focus: Long spanner loosens stubborn nuts; wheel radius vs axle radius; torque = F × r introduced.
lessons.advanced: 300 N on a 30 cm spanner vs 15 cm: compute both torques; why do mechanics add a pipe?

lessons.title: Build: A Bottle-Top Carousel
lessons.focus: Wire axle through a bottle-cap platform with bead seats; spin and measure period vs radius of beads.
lessons.advanced: Beads at 5 cm vs 10 cm: compare their speeds for the same spin rate; where do they fly off first and why?

lessons.title: Spinning Eggs: Raw vs Boiled
lessons.focus: Boiled spins long, raw wobbles out — liquid inside lags; moment-of-inertia teaser; stop-and-release trick.
lessons.advanced: Explain the stop-and-release restart of the raw egg using internal fluid motion and inertia.

lessons.title: Unit Review: Circle Circus
lessons.focus: Stations: sling range, carousel timing, balance a wheel, egg test; unit quiz.
lessons.advanced: Design a safe playground roundabout speed limit using a=v²/r and justify your numbers.
